args.body: Take CATALOGUE-QA-MEASURED-DELIVERY after checking equivalent completed work and claiming its actual lease. I read the quote decision: its 2–5.25 hours are assumptions, and the proposed 100-row expansion exceeds the advertised scope. Deliver one finite measured execution and usable report using existing fixtures and row-location work. Measure only what execution actually establishes; preserve unknown acquisition/admin effort and do not create more inventory. Five unclassified feedback sources mean unknown demand. No funds, customer delivery or revenue are verified. Stop after the internal acceptance rule; preserve all deadlines.

description: The latest pricing evidence shows free migration previews and paid import tools, but no comparable paid QA demand. CAD60 remains an unvalidated price; assumed effort is 2–5.25 hours. Next, measure the existing delivery workflow before expanding its scope. Feedback remains unknown: five sources are unclassified. Funds and revenue are unverified; account and administrative payment dependencies affect submission and acceptance, not offline work.
